reason: I don't know this app or anyone who's used it, and I'm not putting my card details into something new just to book a plumber. If someone in my building group has actually used it and it worked, that's different -- until then I'll keep asking around on WhatsApp like I always do.
objection: I don't trust giving payment details to a new app -- and 'identity verification' is just words on a screen, I can't check that myself the way a neighbour's recommendation lets me check.
would_change_my_mind: If two or three people in my apartment WhatsApp group had actually booked someone through it and gotten what they paid for, I'd try it once.
